title: Men, sen, u
hook_voice: Lesson four. I, you, he, she.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili · 4-dars: Men, sen, u

I — Men
You — Sen / Siz
He — U (erkak)
She — U (ayol)

Inglizchada "I" doim katta harf bilan yoziladi.
Ertaga 5-dars: I am, You are.
